sources.gs_sdm_groups.csv: Germann, M. & Sambanis, N. 2021. Political Exclusion, Lost Autonomy, and Escalating Conflict over Self-Determination. International Organization 75(1), 178-203。再現データ (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/EI1JMG。CC0)。運動は Sambanis, Germann & Schädel 2018 (JCR 62(3)) の SDM、集団は EPR Core (Vogt ほか 2015)
sources.geoepr_centroids.csv: Vogt, Bormann, Rüegger, Cederman, Hunziker & Girardin 2015. Integrating Data on Ethnicity, Geography, and Conflict: The Ethnic Power Relations Data Set Family. JCR 59(7)。GeoEPR 2021 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。研究のための抜き出しで、ゲームには係数だけを入れる)
sources.cshapes_capitals.csv: Schvitz, Girardin, Rüegger, Weidmann, Cederman & Gleditsch 2022. Mapping the International System, 1886-2019: The CShapes 2.0 Dataset. JCR 66(1)。CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (研究のための抜き出しで、ゲームには係数だけを入れる)
